name: Fukutomi (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Fukutomi town emblem in green: an outlined ring with small knobs enclosing a triangle with horizontal strokes.
history: Flag of the former town of Fukutomi in Hiroshima Prefecture, dissolved on 2005-02-07.

features.role: Fukutomi town emblem — an outlined ring with small knobs enclosing a triangle with horizontal strokes
